Package com.codeup.novabook.repo.impl

Class BookRepositoryImpl

java.lang.Object
com.codeup.novabook.repo.impl.BookRepositoryImpl
All Implemented Interfaces:
IBookRepository, IGeneralRepository<Book,Integer>
public class BookRepositoryImpl extends Object implements IBookRepository
JDBC implementation of the IBookRepository interface using JdbcTemplateLight.

This repository manages Book entities with inventory control, availability tracking, and catalog search capabilities. Critical for loan transaction support with atomic stock operations.

Key Features:

  • ISBN uniqueness validation
  • Atomic stock increase/decrease operations
  • Multi-criteria search (title, author, category, ISBN)
  • Availability filtering for loan eligibility
  • Active/inactive catalog management
  • Simplified database operations with JdbcTemplateLight
